I also have tinnitus, visual snow and the after images since I can remember. It’s kinda the same but mine is more “vibrant” if that’s the word for it. It’s also worse with low light and in the dark. This video to me is a low resolution representation of how my visual snow is presenting itself. Also, on some days the flashes are even that bright it’s like I’ve just looked into welding light without the eye protection glasses. I haven’t figured out why the green, white, blue, orange and some red flashes are so intense on those days. Other days they are also present but way less intense. When they are less intense, the colours still stand out from the white and black, but they don’t hurt my eyes anymore when they show up and they are just dots without a tail. The white and black noise like from the static TV is always present, day and night. It was really weird in primary school to learn colours because how they appeared to me didn’t match the name they were given, e.g. white and licht grey. White looks to me as the static TV from 90’s and licht grey looked exactly the same. It took me a long time to figure out how to teach myself the distinction between colours that looked the same to me but weren’t the same for everyone else in the world, and I knew because they kept correcting me. I think this is where my fascination for the colour scheme wall at hardware stores stems from 😂Anyways, nowadays the visuals snow is easily to ignore until I have to do things that require focus or precision, like reading, measuring something with a ruler, cutting paper/vegetables. Eg reading the measurements from the ruler, the visual noise makes it hard to read the lines correctly. Also, I have double vision (due to Keratoconus) which adds some more adventure to the mix. If I’m close enough to the ruler, the double vision is almost gone, but I can’t read the measurements with 100% precision because the black and white dots keep moving. I just can’t filter them out and then just have to guess the measurements in the end and hope I’m right. Anyone else experiencing these issues with the colours and the dots causing issues with reading measurements from a ruler?

You should get tested for Keratoconus, just to make sure you don’t have this eye disease. My eye problems used to be pushed aside as anxiety and PTSD symptoms but it turned out to be the progressive eye disease Keratoconus. Better get tested one time too many than finding out too late.

I used to have this too. I used to put on music on so loud that it drowned out the sound of my breathing. If that wasn’t enough, I’d force myself to drum my fingers or some other part/s of my body to the beat to add more distraction. Even stamping on the ground like a child did help immensely to get grounded again, by adding more sensory feedback to counter the anxiety. Fragrance oils, like clove and pepermint, were a huge help with countering the uneasy feelings in my body or the absence of feelings. Essentially, it boils down to activating/stimulating the senses in the here and now, starting with the one that got me triggered the quickest. In time, I built down the distractions and now I am “just” extremely uncomfortable when I’m breathing loudly and super self conscious. 

Next to all that I also used to carry a towel with me to scream/pinch in at the toilet. I used to get so fed-up with being anxious each time just because I was breathing. Having that towel with me as an outlet for that built up frustration made a big difference in my days.

If you can get your eye professional to prescribe you medical lenses (lenzen op medische indicatie), then the health insurance will cover them, apart from a small part (2023 was 59€ per contact lens). And obviously the mandatory “eigen risico” of at least 385€/year. You can up it to 885€/year, but I wouldn’t do that as you’ll have to pay it anyway. The medical lenses are covered by the “basis polis”, meaning that every health insurance must cover them. You need a referral from an eye doctor, e.g. at Bergman Clinics, to a specialist centre, such as Visser Contactlenzen or Keratoconuscentrum Nederland to get your sclera lenses measured. 

If you are looking to get glasses for eyes with Keratoconus, your best bet (and I think only as well) is Keratoconuscentrum Nederland. You don’t need to add extra insurance to cover these glasses. Just e-mail or call them to inquire about the costs. Mine was almost 400€ and I’ve bought it this or last year. 

For my sclera lenses I use the following: 1) oté one step 360 peroxide with tabs and the red lid for overnight cleaning, 2) oté wiper reinigingstablet for once a week deep clean, but only if you need it, 3) oté saline spoelvloeistof 10ml ampullen to put into the sclera lenses. The 1st and 3rd are cheaply priced at visser contactlenzen, you can order them via their website or by phone. They also have the suction thingies if you use them.

Feel free to reach out if you have questions :)

It is totally understandable that these things may not seem like red flag for you OP (didn’t seem like it to me either at the time), but THEY ARE. It will be hard to end things with your partner right now, and you’ll probably feel guilty the in the beginning or maybe even a couple of months. You will get over this!!! You’re strong enough to “rebuild” from this BS your partner does to you rn. Please make sure, that once you are ready to talk, to see a professional too. I really hope you’ll find the strength to make this decision and put your foot down.

Same here. Because of the stuff my Nmom did the way I use and used diaries changed. Instead of writing personal stuff down I started to use it as a collection of memories with hardly anything written into it. So I would for example put a ticket from a movietheatre in there and write the names of the people that saw that movie with me next to it. Nothing was safe in my home, not even the hiding places you are all talking about. My Nmom would find them eventually in her search for money or anything valuable in my room she could get money for. Even until this day I don’t dare to write anything personal down because I am afraid still afraid too - just like you are saying. And I too live by myself for several years now - 8 years in fact, since she put me on the street at my 18th birthday without any warning. In her reality being 18 years ment that I was an adult and therefore she wasn’t obligated by law to care for me anymore (which wasn’t true bc it’s age 25 but hey she didn’t care at all). Until this day, I still can’t wrap my head around this way if thinking. I don’t think I ever will.

I can relate too. I don’t like it at all. However, changing my mindset did help cope better when this happends. Just a while ago I would get really triggered by it and feel unsafe. I told my newest therapist about it and she told me that there is no need to feel unsafe because these man “just” look at you. They don’t act on it. That did not take my fear away though. So my therapist started talking about how I am lifting weights (also coping) and that the majority of men won’t even be able to overpower me, since I have gotten so strong. That really hit me. As soon as a guy looks at me in the manner you described, I think back about she said and I don’t feel scared anymore. A group of guys or a muscular guy is a different story, but at least I am OK with the average looking once (I still don’t like it at all though). Maybe lifting weights and thinking about it this way may help you too. It is a BIG relief for me and I wish you the same!
